dashboard.found: Fundor found {{n}} opportunities based on your company profile. Here are the matches that matter for your decision.
dashboard.empty: No matches at this relevance level yet.

list.title: Grants
list.subtitle: Every match ranked against your company profile. The eligibility engine filters out what you don't qualify for in advance.
list.gatedSubtitle: Your company profile qualifies for {{n}} calls. The scores and amounts below are real.

card.exclusionFallback: An exclusion criterion is not met

teaser.notStated: Grant: the call does not state one
teaser.note: The score and the amount are real figures computed for your company profile. The call name, its deadline and the submission link unlock with a subscription.
teaser.noteEmpty: Your matches unlock with a subscription.
teaser.moreBody: A subscription opens the full result list, the five-factor reasoning, the grant calculator and the submission links. Access is granted by an administrator for now — no payment gateway is connected yet.

notFound.title: This call is no longer available
notFound.body: Its deadline may have passed, or it may have been withdrawn from the portal.

gated.title: Call details unlock with a subscription
gated.body: Without an active subscription the call's name, deadline and links are withheld — only the score and the amount are shown, on the list.

breakdown.title: Fundor Score breakdown
breakdown.subtitle: Five factors, weighted per the specification. Click a factor for the detailed justification.

why.title: Why we recommend this
why.subtitle: Every statement follows from your own concrete data and references the official call.

blocked.title: This call is not relevant based on your company profile
blocked.body: The rule-based eligibility engine found at least one exclusion criterion. Scoring cannot override it.

consortium.title: Consortium requirement
consortium.body: This call cannot be submitted alone: at least {{partners}} independent organisations from {{countries}} different Member States are required.
consortium.note: An estimate: one partner's slice of the project grant. Horizon consortia typically run well past the minimum, with eight to fifteen members, so a single partner's share is much smaller than an even split.

calculator.title: Grant calculator
calculator.subtitle: From the project value in your profile and the funding intensity.
calculator.hintShare: The calculation is capped at your estimated partner share (about {{max}}), not the whole project grant.
calculator.hintCeiling: Funding is capped at the ceiling ({{max}}).
calculator.hintNone: The call does not publish a funding ceiling.
calculator.fromProfile: The project value comes from your company profile. Change it there and the calculation updates.

apply.title: How to apply
apply.body: Submission happens in the funder's own system — Fundor points you there, and the call text is always the authority on the conditions.
apply.curatedNote: This is a curated reference entry for a Hungarian national programme, not a record pulled from the portal. The figures reflect the programme's typical parameters — always check the official call text before applying.
apply.curatedPortalSub: palyazat.gov.hu — this is where official calls are published

source.label: Source
source.curated: Hungarian national programme — curated reference entry
source.disclaimer: The eligibility output is a pre-screen, not an official determination.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Search every open and forthcoming European and Hungarian call. Results are scored against your company profile.
search.placeholder: Search a topic, programme or identifier — e.g. hydrogen, digitalisation, HORIZON-CL4

empty.title: No results
empty.body: Try a broader term, or remove a filter.

calendar.title: Funding Calendar
calendar.subtitle: You don't have to track the deadlines — Fundor tracks them for you. Only relevant matches with a Fundor Score of 70+ are shown.
calendar.gatedSubtitle: Your upcoming submission deadlines. The dates unlock with a subscription — until then you can see how many are waiting and how much money is involved.
calendar.empty: No upcoming deadlines among your relevant matches.
calendar.notice: Deadline reminders (30/14/7/3 days) and .ics export are not available yet. With staged evaluation the budget may run out before the deadline.

saved.title: Saved
saved.subtitle: Your saved opportunities in one place.
saved.emptyTitle: You have no saved grants yet
saved.emptyBody: Use the “Save” button on a match's detail page to put here whatever you want to revisit.
saved.gated: Saved calls unlock with a subscription.
